findings.current: Ju Hwaran smiled approvingly at the sight of Mujin deftly massaging me
findings.defect: The source says Mujin was quick to read the situation as he massaged Taekyung. “Deftly” instead describes his massage technique, losing the character-reading cue.
findings.rationale: 눈치 빠르게 describes Mujin’s quick perception, not the skillfulness of his hands.
findings.replacement: Ju Hwaran smiled approvingly at how quickly Mujin had caught on and started massaging me

findings.current: I’d hoped to see that bastard muzzled before I died……
findings.defect: The source expresses Namho’s insistence that he has to see the man muzzled before he dies. “I’d hoped” turns that resolve into a past hope.
findings.rationale: 내가 죽기 전에 … 봐야 하는데 conveys that seeing it before his death is something he must do.
findings.replacement: I have to see that bastard muzzled before I die……

summary: Two minor fidelity shifts: a character-reading cue becomes massage skill, and Namho’s resolve becomes a past hope.
